syllabus_topics: Characteristics of the final exam defined by the Bachelor's Degree Regulations
Final judgment by the Graduate Committee
Option for written exam in English with an extended summary in Italian
assessment_rules: The final exam is oral and involves the writing of a final paper. The material will be evaluated by a preparatory committee, which formulates an opinion and forwards it to the Graduate Committee for the final judgment. The final exam may be written and taken in English; in this case, an extended summary in Italian must also be prepared.
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Elettronica (Electronic Engineering), classe L-8 R Ingegneria dell'informazione
